situation: A Tier-1 Banking & FSI account is evaluating Agentic Harness for fraud alert reviews. It would pay through seats growing into VPC usage. Risk committees block anything they cannot audit, even when the business case is strong.

consumption_profile.seasonality: volume spikes in November and December

forecast.speaker: CIO
forecast.partial: There is a lot of volume in fraud alert reviews and it keeps growing, but I would need to pull the exact numbers.
forecast.verbatim: We handle 1.2 million alerts a month today, growing about 15 percent a year, and volume spikes in November and December.

ramp.speaker: CIO
ramp.partial: We will not sign a large commit on agent runs before we see real usage.
ramp.verbatim: We can commit to 60 percent of that forecast in year one and run the rest on demand until usage proves out.
